title: Paged-Attention KV block allocator vs block size (real C++)
info: Real C++: sweeps 7 power-of-two KV block sizes to minimize total allocated bytes (internal fragmentation + per-block table overhead) for a fixed token-size workload, compiled by clang++.
useful bytes is invariant across candidates, so maximizing the ratio reduces to an exact integer minimization -- no floating point involved in the choice.
